items.label: [Two Is Better]
items.value: Set of 2 rattan nightstands, a more space-coordinated home space! Plug in your lamps or phones on this narrow end table with 2 AC outlets, 1 USB port and 1 Type-c port, it will provide power close at hand

items.label: [Fresh and Elegant Style]
items.value: Need a storage table without disturbing the home colour balance? This rattan side table with light wooden colour is exactly what you need. What’s more significant, the PE rattan design on the drawer surface brings an irresistible and attractive boho vibe to your space

items.label: [Large Storage]
items.value: It’s time to give your sofa side items a designated spot. The spacious desktop, large drawer, and open shelf of this bed side table with drawer have got ready for greeting your books, lamp, and other bedside items well

items.label: [Surprised by the Quality]
items.value: Solid wood for four legs, sturdy P2 particleboard for the overall body, durable and stable, set this narrow nightstand in your home with the confidence that it will accompany you for years to come

items.label: [Save Time]
items.value: Tedious assembly may rob you of some happy time, but that does not happen on this nightstand with drawer. With clear instructions, and numbered components, this charging nightstand will be finished quickly
